text: The RBA raised its cash rate 25 basis points to 4.85%, an 18-year high, in a 6-3 vote. September CPI rose 4.3% YoY, versus 4% in August. Annual GDP growth slowed from 2.5% in Q1 to 2.1% in Q2. Inflation remains above the 2%-3% target range.

meta.note: The rate decision was split; the inflation target remains unmet.

text: AMD reported Q3 revenue of $13.38 billion (+45% YoY) and adjusted EPS of $2.09. Data center revenue nearly doubled, reaching 64% of total sales versus 47% a year earlier. PC and gaming revenue declined 8% to $3.7 billion, with gaming down 40%. Shares rose 8% after hours.

meta.note: PC and gaming figures are combined at segment level; gaming decline is reported separately.
